messages.content: The Q2 revenue for Nexoma Labs was $4.2M, up 18% year-over-year. Operating expenses were $3.1M, driven primarily by R&D ($1.8M) and sales and marketing ($0.9M). Net income was $1.1M, compared to $0.6M in Q2 of last year. Cash on hand is $6.4M. Headcount grew from 42 to 51.

response.content: Nexoma Labs had a strong second quarter. Revenue and net income were both up compared to last year, expenses grew mainly due to R&D and marketing spending, and the company added several new employees while maintaining a healthy cash position.
